Commendations
15 Aug, 2015 @ 8:30am
👅 f r e a k y c y r u s 👅
Is there really any reason to commend someone with a text box? Ive gotten quite a few commends and havent ever noticed any comments on them or any way to view them.

Reports I can understand to have a text box, but considering Valve uses a bot to do it then I dont think its really the greatest thing.

I think the Reborn should have a screen to see your Commends/Reports with the following information:
Game information
Any comments
Who commended you
What they commended you for

And a similar one with reports:
Game information
Who reported you
Any reason they reported you for


This would honestly help a lot.
